note: Routing corpus of record (minted 2026-07-13; reciprocal negatives against instructions-and-guardrails/observability/orchestration-and-workflows added 2026-07-13 per independent audit). Positives: imperative / diagnostic / symptom / indirect phrasings across the four axes (typed tool schemas, deferred tool-catalog loading, read-only resources, general external-service integration). Negatives drawn adversarially from the dangerous near-neighbors: llm-provider-gateway (the sibling pack that owns the FULL LLM-provider adapter/registry/dev-proxy pattern this pack's a18 only routes to — the single most important negative, since a18 is directly adjacent), chat-harness-knowledge-and-memory (persisting facts/memory, not calling tools/services), chat-harness-skills-and-routing (a skill library's OWN routing, the SKILL-loading analogue of a16, not this pack's TOOL-loading axis), chat-harness-instructions-and-guardrails (which action-risk tier a tool call falls into, not the tool/resource/service distinction itself), chat-harness-observability (logging that a tool fired, not what makes something a tool in the first place), chat-harness-orchestration-and-workflows (an AGENT calling another agent is a composition concern, not this pack's tool/resource/service axis), plus a genuine build/implement ask (this pack answers, it does not build).
